title: Elixir of Peerless Focus
summary: Until Long Rest, gain advantage on Concentration checks and saves against Charmed effects, and immunity to Sleeping.

fields.Drink: Bonus Action. Consume one bottle. Until Long Rest, gain advantage on Concentration checks and saves against Charmed effects, and immunity to Sleeping.
fields.Stacking: Replaces other normal elixirs and can be overwritten by another.
fields.Crafting: Combine Sublimate of Belladonna with any Ashes.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
